Disables shared-memory capture and uses regular JPEG or PNG screenshots instead. Parallel encoding remains enabled. Default `false`.

## CLI flag

```text
--disable-shared-memory-capture
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#disablesharedmemorycapture)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#disablesharedmemorycapture)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#disablesharedmemorycapture)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDisableSharedMemoryCapture(true);
```
